claims: A potential "Super El Niño" is projected to develop by summer 2026.
A potential "Super El Niño" is projected to last through the end of 2026.
El Niño is forecasted to emerge by summer 2026.
Rapid development of the El Niño is predicted after the collapse of the previous La Niña phase.
There is a 62% chance of El Niño conditions developing by June-August 2026.
There is a 1-in-3 chance of the El Niño becoming a "strong" or "super" event by late 2026.
2024 is currently expected to remain the warmest year.
The 2026 El Niño event is expected to increase wind shear across the Atlantic.
Increased wind shear across the Atlantic typically reduces tropical storm formation in the second half of the 2026 hurricane season.
The anticipated 2026 El Niño event follows the strong 2023-2024 El Niño.
